title: Enhancement: Add platform support for Micas W6940 switch
author: yifei-micas
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

Add test coverage for the Micas W6940 switch in the community test suite.

### Current Behavior

Micas W6940 switch is not supported.

### Proposed Behavior

Micas W6940 switch will be supported in sonic-mgmt.

Summary:
Add QoS SAI test support for the `M2-W6940-64X1-FR4` Broadcom TH5 platform.
This change registers the HWSKU as TH5, adds QoS parameters for the `topo-ft2-CPO-64` topology, and applies the existing TH5-specific packet-count and watermark handling to the platform.

Fixes #27780

All qos test case in sonic-mgmt supporting th5 platform should pass

- Added `M2-W6940-64X1-FR4` to `broadcom_th5_hwskus`.
- Added QoS parameters for the `topo-ft2-CPO-64` topology in
  `qos_params.th5.yaml`.
- Applied the existing TH5 behavior used by TH5 platforms to
  `M2-W6940` in the relevant SAI QoS tests
